pairs.evidence: app/features/library/jds/jdsLedgerArtifacts.ts:127 This context is a client-side table and detail view that only reads JD rows from the API. A search of app/features/library/jds/ for ALTER TABLE, CREATE TABLE, user_version, schema_version and PRAGMA found nothing, so the context has no migration step, ledger or runner. Its only link to the subject is reader tolerance: readBuildIntent returns null for rows written before build_input_json existed, and the column itself is added in app/_lib/db/core.ts:2321, outside this context.

techniques.evidence: app/features/library/jds/jdsLedgerArtifacts.ts:108 The reader tolerates rows that lack the added column. That is the expand side seen from a consumer, but this context owns no schema change. The rename or drop sequencing belongs to the db layer.
